why: Intro to Jupyter plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-jupyter.json), 'Install a package and draw a chart' (the install half): %pip install matplotlib ran in the notebook. pip printed its resolver notice ('ERROR: pip's dependency resolver does not currently take into account ...' about jupyterlab and jupyter-lsp, a package this lesson never uses), then 'Successfully installed ... matplotlib-3.9.2'. The next cell, import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, ran with no error ([3]). matplotlib is installed in the kernel.

step.title: Install matplotlib from the notebook
step.instructions: In a new cell in steps.ipynb, run %pip install matplotlib and wait for 'Successfully installed'. Then run import matplotlib.pyplot as plt in the cell below.
